Edtech platforms, assistant apps and podcast studios lean on exactly that two-way ease.

name: Graciela - Reels, Ads

Ideal for narrations, documentaries, inspirational stories, spiritual messages, biblical readings, and audiobooks. Features a measured pace, clear articulation, and subtle emotion—an elegant, immersive voice that commands attention and lends weight to every word.

name: Taksh - Viral Social Media Influencer
description: Engaging, relatable and interactive — Taksh sounds like the guy filming on his phone between two errands, talking straight to camera with an easy, conversational male warmth that turns a product review into something you reply to instead of scroll past. That natural, ask-the-viewer delivery lands reels, Shorts, vlog voiceovers, comment polls and sponsored mentions that still sound like a tip from a friend. Lifestyle brands book him for feeds that need trust more than noise.

name: Vikram - Influencer for Reels & Shorts
description: Bold, confident and polished — Vikram carries a deeper, more assured male tone than the usual phone-in-hand creator, landing a hot take or a product verdict like a man who has already made up his mind and is letting you catch up. That crisp, no-filler delivery holds vertical video intros, trend commentary, brand collaborations, tech and auto reviews and opinion clips where authority is the hook. Premium lifestyle brands and launch campaigns choose him when the feed needs a verdict, not a vibe.

name: Victor - Halloween Horror Calm Narrator
description: Perfect for narration and storytelling. The voice is low-pitched, calm, and measured, making it a strong choice for immersive storytelling and long-form narration. Its steady delivery lends itself to reflective passages, atmospheric mysteries, and slowly building suspense.Key qualities: Low-pitched, calm, steady, composed, and storytelling-focused.Best for: Audiobooks, documentary narration, fiction podcasts, mystery stories, psychological horror, ghost stories, and Halloween storytelling.

name: Tara - Calm Empathetic Insurance Agent
description: Gentle, compassionate and soothing, Tara is the one a person hears on the hardest day of their life, low and unhurried enough to let the news land, then kind enough to say what to do about it. She eases a family through death-claim intimation, term plan payouts, claim status and document steps in small, clear pieces, never hurrying and never hiding behind a script. Life insurers and claims desks turn to her whenever a nominee needs to feel held before being asked for anything.

name: Natraj - Fearful, Scared Character
description: Scared, anxious and trembling — Natraj stammers through a line like the words are the only thing between him and whatever is coming, his breath catching mid-sentence and his voice cracking a beat before the dread lands. He is the hostage pleading into a phone, the character whispering from inside a cupboard, the witness who saw too much, and horror games, survival thrillers and chase sequences all run on that unravelling. Game studios cast him when a scene needs a man coming apart.

name: Germain Deutsch - Direct & Articulate
description: An English voice with a German accent - natural and assured. Clearly enunciated, it is easy to understand, suiting any project that needs authentic German-accented English, from narration to explainer videos. Originally recorded reading non-fiction texts, the delivery is grounded, honest and direct: every sentence lands with proactive, deliberate certainty, as if stating plain fact. Down to earth with a dynamic edge and a steady presence, it keeps listeners engaged and trusting.

name: Arijit M - Engaging Reels Creator
description: Expressive, Interactive, Polished — Arijit M opens with a hook, lands the reaction, and throws a question back at the viewer, all in a bright Indian English male delivery that sounds like a real person behind the phone. That conversational spark carries comment polls, food and travel vlogs, tech unboxings, trend breakdowns, and the odd sponsored mention without tipping into a hard sell. Built for social media feeds, channels, and influencer-led brand promotions.

name: Marilyn - Warm Clear, British
description: A calm, clear British female voice with a warm, reassuring character. Marilyn is well suited to customer-facing voice assistants, conversational AI, virtual receptionists and customer support, bringing a welcoming, approachable tone to everyday interactions. Her gentle delivery also lends itself beautifully to guided meditations, relaxation, reflective storytelling and thoughtful narration.

Discover Mailo for narratives, voiceovers, and explanatory content—and see for yourself, using your own text, just how much impact a warm voice can create.

name: Jesse - Animation Character, Friendly
description: Warm, natural, and friendly male voice with clear, expressive delivery and a genuine, approachable tone. Ideal for animated characters, storytelling, and dialogue-driven projects. Perfect for heroes, sidekicks, narrators, everyday characters, and friendly leads in animation, games, and short-form content.

description: I'm a professional American male narrator. I can carry long story narration or quick, engaging social media posts. My voice is soft, smooth, and clear. I speed up when the moment needs energy and slow down when it matters. I pause for tension and sound natural, like I'm talking to a friend. Studio-quality, close mic, no background noise.

name: Agastya - Fearful, Tense Character

Game studios, indie developers, horror podcasts and Halloween campaigns reach for exactly this register for escape rooms and survival thrillers.

No surprise wellness startups, app studios and Hindi mindfulness channels build entire routines around her pacing.

name: Simran - Fast Paced Outbound SDR

Perfect for Hindi outbound stacks seeking a sales voice that sounds human, not scripted.

Short films, web series, audiobooks and podcasts turn to this kind of restraint when a scene needs to hurt quietly.

name: Agastya - Fun, Relatable Comedy Creator

Perfect for roasts, wedding gags, sketch dubbing, reaction videos, and fast-paced social content that needs personality, clarity, and punch.

Built for lead follow-ups, appointment reminders, renewal nudges. Ideal for sales teams, loan offers, insurance, subscriptions.
